contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ CONSTANTINVS [?IVN NC] ; R/ VICTORIAE LAETAE PRINC PERP

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus, probably of Constantine II (317-340), Two Victories issue of 318-320, probably Trier mint, Reece period 16. Obverse description: Bust helmeted and cuirassed left. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTINVS [?IVN NC]. Reverse description: Two Victories facing each other holding wreath inscribed VOT / PR over altar. Reverse inscription: VICTORIAE LAETAE PRINC PERP. In exergue: probably PTR. Diameter: 16.9mm, Weight: 2.30gms, die axis: 6
